title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:21-26
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:21-26</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="21" /> You have heard that <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">it was said</char> to the ancients, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        “You shall not commit <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">murder</char>,” 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        and “Whoever commits <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">murder</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">will be guilty</char> by the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">court</char>.” 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="22" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">And I say</char> to you, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        that everyone who is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">angry</char> with <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">his brother</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">will be guilty</char> by the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">court</char>; 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        and whoever says to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">his brother</char>, “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">You good-for-nothing</char>,” 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">will be guilty</char> by the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Sanhedrin</char>; 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
        and whoever says, “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">You fool</char>,” 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c''">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">will be guilty</char> for the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">gehenna of fire</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="23" /> Therefore <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">if</char> you are <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">presenting your offering</char> at <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">the altar</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        and there remember that <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">your brother</char> has something against you, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="24" /> leave <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">your offering</char> there before <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">the altar</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        and go, first be reconciled to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">your brother</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">then</char> come and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">present your offering</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> Settle matters in a friendly way with your <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="tan">legal opponent</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        while you are with him on the way, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        so that your <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="tan">opponent</char> doesn’t hand you over to the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">court-judge</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">court-judge</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the officer</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        so you’re thrown into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">prison</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="26" /> Truly I say to you, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        you will not come out of there 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        until you have paid up the last coin. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
